name: Daemon Totem, Greater
body:
Daemon Totem, Greater (Su)
Source Horror Adventures pg. 46
If the barbarian kills an intelligent creature with a CR equal to at least half her character level while raging, she heals 5 hit points. If she is already at her maximum number of hit points, she instead gains 5 temporary hit points, which don’t stack if she kills multiple creatures. A barbarian must be at least 10th level and have the lesser daemon totem and daemon totem rage powers to select this rage power.
